QuestInfo.name: It's All in the Mind
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p404# in #m10003000# has finally crafted the #o17# phobia cure.
QuestInfo.1: I need to deliver the #b#t4031114##k crafted by #p404# to #b#p417##k at the subway entrance in #b#m10003000##k. I hope this helps... \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the #t4031114# crafted by #p404# to #p417# at the subway entrance in #m10003000#. Truth be told, it seems like a medicine with little to no actual effect, but if it gave #p417# the courage he needed, perhaps that is enough.

0.0: Great. Now all the ingredients are ready. Now, wait just a moment. I'll craft the cure in no time. Let's see here...
0.1: Here, take this freshly made #b#t4031114##k. Thanks to my grandfather's gummies, it's sweet, tasty, and good for your health.

yes.0: Oh, and I think I should tell you this... Honestly, this isn't a cure for a phobia of #o17#. It's just a common health supplement. But hey, if he eats this and feels like his phobia is cured, isn't that all that matters? Haha!

1.0: You're back! Is this really the #t4031114#...? Could this finally cure my long-standing fear of #o17#? Phew... I'm a little scared, but since #p404# made it for me, it shouldn't be dangerous, right? Well, here goes... gulp gulp
1.1: Phew... Having taken the medicine, I don't really feel any different from usual. Hmm... Though somehow, I feel like I have a bit more energy than normal? Could it be that my fear of #o17# is truly cured? Haha! At any rate, thank you so much for helping me. I can't suffer from past traumas forever, so I'm going to try living my life with a bit more passion from now on!

npc.0: Hand over the #t4031114# I made to #p417#. Once you do, all his problems will be solved. Heheh...

item.0: You're back! So #p404# made the #t4031114# for me? But where is that medicine?

lost.0: You lost the #t4031114# I made? Whew... But don't worry. Knowing something like this might happen, I made an extra.
